S1014.reason: Under the majority rule, spread of an ordinary leaf fire is judged by negligence, and leaving the burn unattended breaches reasonable care when a gust can carry embers.

S0885.reason: Contemporary practice has largely dropped formal recognition of governments in favor of functional dealings with whoever exercises effective control.

S0006.reason: A fluctuating, well-transilluminating scrotal swelling with a normal testicular scan is a communicating hydrocele, and an adolescent is treated by surgical repair.
